objective: Create frontend/src/styles/tokens.css and base.css exactly as wiki/CodeContext/FrontendUI/tokens.md specifies, imported once from main.tsx, guarded by a static token-contrast test.
acceptance_criteria: src/styles/tokens.css declares every token in tokens.md sections 2, 4 and 8 on :root, and redeclares every semantic colour token (section 4) inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark).

A static test parses tokens.css, resolves var() references, computes WCAG 2.1 contrast without rounding, and asserts every pair in tokens.md section 5 meets its minimum in both themes; changing the dark --color-link to #1f7a8c makes it fail.
No banned pair from tokens.md section 6 is declared as a token pair, and no dark-theme token has the value #1f7a8c.
base.css gives :focus-visible a 2px solid var(--color-focus) outline with a 2px offset, and contains no outline: none or outline: 0 outside a rule that also sets a :focus-visible replacement.

base.css declares color-scheme: light dark, styles [aria-invalid="true"] form controls with var(--color-danger), styles :disabled controls with var(--opacity-disabled), and defines a .visually-hidden class.
Under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), --duration-fast and --duration-base are 0ms, and no @keyframes rule exists anywhere under frontend/src.
Every existing test in the suite passes unchanged; no existing test file is edited.
